description: Agent Capacity: submit an agent’s spare capacity with its plan: the capacity with the total and its unit; the plan with the spare capacity it keeps as a reserve and the capacity it keeps for urgent work; the load with the capacity in use now, the capacity standing or recurring work takes and the headroom the system recorded; each past demand spike with its id, date, peak demand and whether the records show it absorbed; and each urgent request with its id, date, the capacity it needed and how it was served (on time, delayed or refused). The signed report gives the headroom the load leaves with its share of the total beside the recorded headroom, the planned and urgent reserves with what is left after the reserve, the share standing work takes and what it leaves, every spike against the total with its absorption, and every urgent request with how it was served, and counts them, and names headroom gone: a load at or over the total, headroom under the planned reserve, and headroom under the urgent reserve or an urgent request refused; then standing work that alone eats into the reserve, spikes not absorbed or larger than the total, urgent requests served late and a recorded headroom more than 5% of the total above the headroom the load leaves, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No total, current load, reserve, urgent reserve, standing load or spike record leaves the headroom unverified. This reads spare capacity against the reserve the plan calls for: whether a limit’s remaining room is shown before acting is wever_limit-visibility-check and a treasury balance against a reserve floor is wever_budget-forecast-brief. Verdict capacity_headroom_none, capacity_headroom_partial, capacity_headroom_unverified or capacity_headroom_adequate. POST /api/capacity-headroom-check. Reads the load and capacity records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Capacity reads an agent’s own load and capacity records and checks the load against the capacity that exists: work in hand against the stated limit, a queue against its target wait, concurrent runs against the cap, an allowance’s burn against its period, a backlog across a window, spare capacity against the reserve, the scaling plan against the burn, and admission at capacity against written priority rules. Beside it, the Agent Limits checks such as wever_limit-substrate-check read whether a limit sits in code or in prose and how it is scoped, changed and seen, while a capacity check reads the load itself against the capacity; wever_commitment-deadline-check reads promised hours against due dates, while the workload check reads the work in hand against the stated limit over time; and the Agent Triage checks such as wever_triage-priority-check read how queue items are ranked, reviewed and closed, while the queue, backlog and throttle checks read waits, size and admission against capacity. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-capacity-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-capacity/.
